1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora, fibrosa, que produce las semillas dentro de un cilindro puntiagudo dividido en pequeñas celdas de fibra fuerte. Esta cápsula es fibrosa y áspera. La usan para fregar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant with fibrous stems that produces seeds within a pointed cylinder divided into small cells of strong fiber. This capsule is fibrous and rough. It is used for scrubbing.
